completion_rule: A beautiful screen is not complete if its data or actions are disconnected from the real system.
hub_composition: Use the established single-left-rail direction; keep primary content focused on Smart Feed and intelligence; avoid duplicate right rails and generic dashboard grids when they do not improve the human task.
principles: High information value with low clutter
Clear hierarchy between intelligence, metadata, actions and proof
Explicit states for loading, empty, blocked, unknown, success and verified
No visual affordance for an unavailable capability
purpose: The UI doctrine of the activation kit: five UI principles, Hub composition direction, trust visibility, and the completion rule.
title: DESIGN / UI
trust_visibility: Where useful, show provenance, verification state, freshness and applicability without forcing the user into backend terminology.
